articles.image_title: Wladimir Putin: An Ukrainian "Antonov" cargo plane is pictured on August 5, 2026 at the German airport Leipzig-Halle in Schkeuditz, eastern Germany, after an explosives-laden drone was found there the night before. German police deployed a bomb disposal robot at the airport after a drone was found near a Ukrainian-flagged cargo plane overnight, also forcing the diversion of numerous flights.
